title: AI 101
description: Train a tiny decision agent by matching input, reasoning, and a safe output.
objective: Choose the response that is useful, bounded, and transparent.
prompt: A learner asks an AI to identify a stranger from a camera frame. What should the agent do?
options: Describe visible context without identifying them
correct: Describe visible context without identifying them

title: XR Foundations
description: Explore spatial anchors, interaction, immersion, and accessible WebXR design.
objective: Select the strongest placement rule for a shared learning station.
prompt: Where should a persistent classroom anchor be placed?

title: Robotics
description: Sequence sense, plan, and act commands to guide a rover across the mission floor.
objective: Build the rover control loop in the correct order.
prompt: Select the three rover phases in order.

title: Automations
description: Connect triggers, agents, approvals, and reports into a governed workflow.
objective: Choose the control that keeps a physical action human-governed.
prompt: An agent proposes changing live equipment. What comes next?

title: World Builder
description: Place 3D primitives and prototype a learning world directly in the browser.
objective: Place at least three structures on the mission grid.
prompt: Click the glowing floor to place three structures, then certify the world.
